blocks.text: Both Welpers and customers have the ability to cancel the service for free up until 24 hours before the time of the service.
If the customer cancels the service less than 24 hours before the time of the service, 1 hour of pay will be kept by Welpco to pay the Welper.
If the Welper cancels the service less than 24 hours before the time of the service, Welpco will issue a full refund to the customer.
If a customer doesn't receive the service they paid for due to the Welper's cancellation or absence, the customer will receive a full refund.
If the customer is not satisfied with the service they received, they may contact us directly via the app or website and express their complaint, while submitting any necessary proof, such as:

items: Photos of the result of the service they received.

blocks.text: Welpco will then assess the complaint and contact the customer with our decision, which could include either of the following:

items: A credit to use towards a future transaction;
A designated Welper will be selected by Welpco to complete or re-do the service at no cost to the customer.

blocks.text: In all cases, customers have the ability to rate and leave reviews for Welpers once a job is complete, which will be visible to all customers. Likewise, Welpers have the ability to rate and leave reviews based on their experience with customers.

If the Welper shows up on time for the service and the service requires the customer to be present, but they are absent, the service will be cancelled if the customer doesn't communicate their absence or late arrival with the Welper and an hour of pay will be kept to pay the Welper, and the remainder of the payment will be issued as a refund to the customer.
This is a transparent process that encourages positive experiences between customers and Welpers alike.
